description: Comment intake, binning and summarization are now tool-assisted in production (FWS DocketScope deployed 2025-08, analyst-verified) and in pilots at EPA Region 8, USDA OCIO and BLM (GraphRAG). Work shifts from coding comments to validating machine coding and tracing responses. DOI's PCAT was retired between inventories, so tools churn faster than the role.

role_title: Entry-level comment and document reviewers (GS-5/7 equivalents)
description: If first-pass coding is automated, the tasks through which juniors learned issue-spotting and regulatory reasoning shrink. No staffing data seen to confirm this; consistent with v1 CLD logic.

role_title: Interdisciplinary (ID) team members and planners in forest planning and NEPA
description: USFS deployed 'Forest Plan review and planning support' (Google, 2025-06) and 'Turbo plan' (Wildfire.org, 2025-07); BLM is building NEPA CE document generation and a small language model to consolidate RMP decisions. Planners increasingly review machine-drafted or machine-extracted content.

role_title: Camera-trap image tagger / wildlife technician (image review)
description: Pre-trained detectors and classifiers (MegaDetector + SpeciesNet) are used by Michigan DNR Wildlife Division, TNC California and others; NOAA automates seal, sea lion, whale and fish image counting. Manual image sorting - a traditional seasonal-technician entry task - is being compressed to exception review.
NOAA lists ML to automate review of EM data (Hawaii longline, shrimp, reef fish) and bycatch image libraries. Reviewer role shifts to validating detections and maintaining training libraries.

USGS bat-acoustics ML pilot; NOAA passive acoustic ML for marine mammals; BirdNET exposes train/evaluate commands to non-programmers. Value moves from manual call ID to detection-threshold setting, validation and occupancy inference.

role_title: Remote-sensing compliance analyst for farm programs
description: USDA Farm Production and Conservation is preparing satellite-and-crop-model verification of cover crops and planting dates and validation of acreage/crop type - the only environmental high-impact AI uses in its 2025 inventory. Requires model-risk, validation and appeal-support skills; may change the role of field spot checks (FC to assess).

role_title: Operational forecaster / environmental modeler working with AI emulators
description: NOAA inventory includes an AI-driven global forecast model and ensemble, the Ai2 Climate Emulator collaboration, AI downscaling and bias correction, and hybrid physics-ML models. Modelers must evaluate emulators against physics models and observations.

role_title: Fire intelligence and decision-support specialists (FBAN, LTAN, GISS, IRIN, UAS Data Specialist, Intelligence Support Specialist)
description: Incident analytic roles, coordination-center intelligence and new technology-integration roles (AI detection, camera networks, satellite tasking, data pipelines) are converging faster than NWCG qualifications and OPM series absorb them; classification spans GS-1560/2210/0132/0401.

role_title: Chief AI Officer staff and AI governance board members in environmental agencies
description: M-25-21 required CAIOs within 60 days and AI governance boards (with data representation) at CFO Act agencies; EPA places AI governance in its Data Governance Advisory Committee. Creates demand for staff who can make high-impact determinations and run inventories.

Agency AI strategies recruit for model evaluation and AI ethics roles (per DC-020); M-25-22 requires ongoing performance monitoring in contracts; no environmental-agency position descriptions for this role were found this session.

role_title: GIS technician (layer creation and map production)
description: v1 codes 2.1.1 T1 as CLD-Moderate. Inventory shows generative tools writing ArcGIS scripts and AI assistants inside Esri tools (pilots). Direct evidence of reduced GIS-technician hiring was not found; LM to test with posting data.

USDA NRCS DS Hub is piloting generative metadata for geospatial datasets; v1 codes 2.2.5 T3 as V (pipeline is primary executor). Work shifts from authoring to reviewing machine-generated metadata and sensitivity screening.

NOAA AI QC of water-level and ocean observations, IOOS coastal modeling sandbox, edge-AI survey payloads; USGS/USDA sensor QC. A distinct engineering role between field technicians and analysts, poorly captured by v1.

role_title: Environmental permit processor and applicant-assistance staff
description: USDA OCIO pilots AI triage predicting whether an application is a simple categorical exclusion; FWS is preparing ePermits chatbots and an application wizard. Routine routing compresses; exception handling and applicant guidance remain.

role_title: Environmental data scientist in science bureaus (USGS, NOAA, USFS R&D)
description: USGS alone reports 187 AI use cases (of DOI's 247) and NOAA 157 names; the work is mostly classical ML on Earth observation, hydrology, hazards and species data, increasingly with foundation models. Role shifts from building bespoke models to adapting, validating and operating shared models.
